notes.text: Reading note on John 7:39 — editorial. “The Spirit was not yet” concerns the giving or reception of the Spirit in relation to Jesus’ glorification, as the surrounding verse explains; it is not a statement that the Holy Spirit did not exist. Some English translations supply “given.” The reading text preserves the selected Greek wording. See the linked comparison edition for its textual explanation. This note is separate from the verse.
